scope: Fresh selected-provider source to Linux ARM64 executable to release ZIP, with independently source-built native Darwin Go compilers. This cross-build does not reproduce the whole original Linux x64 publisher workflow or close deeper bootstrap, SDK and notice producers.

moduleGraphMetadataPreparation.qualification: Preparation only; no provider compilation or execution

moduleGraphMetadataInterpretation.rawGoModH1Encoding: h1: plus base64(SHA256(hex(SHA256(raw go.mod)) + two spaces + go.mod + newline))

frozenBuildRecipe.purpose: Fresh provider source to executable to release ZIP with source-built compilers; no provider/model execution

providerCompiler.role: Native Darwin ARM64 host intermediates produced during the source build of the exact Linux ARM64 Go 1.26.8 SDK

frozenBuildRecipe.packagingBehavior: Two original source-bound entries with fixed source commit time; original publisher zipper behavior independently reimplemented, not the whole publisher CLI
frozenBuildRecipe.executionTrust: Operator-authorized host build; not a sandbox

preservedRejectedPreparation.qualification: Prerequisite failure only; provider compilation did not start and no build was qualified
preservedRejectedPreparation.cause: The 58 selected module ZIPs did not include every required transitive go.mod-only metadata file. GOPROXY=off correctly refused the missing go-cleanhttp v0.5.0 metadata.
preservedRejectedPreparation.correctedWith: All 153 observed go.mod metadata files match the selected source go.sum; the corrected recipe was frozen before fresh builds.

remainingProducerObligations: Deeper bootstrap ancestry, copied/generated compiler and module inputs, original C/compiler/SDK producer builds and complete original notices remain open.
The original publisher action, Linux x64 runner image and complete action dependencies/cache identities have not been independently rebuilt.
Only the bounded original zipper behavior was reimplemented; the complete original publisher CLI was not executed.
The expected selected executable and ZIP were not explicit build inputs. Filesystem isolation and independent network tracing were not provided.
No fresh Checktrail receipt integration or final current-source/native installed-package acceptance is established by these upstream artifact observations.
